channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Calipari | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Calipari from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Falk on John Calipari
item.description:
During an interview with Joe Beningo and Evan Roberts on WFAN Sports Radio in New York,David Falk talked up the Knicks and Calipari.

“I'm waiting for — I'll take bets on how long it's going to take before they hire John Calipari to be the next coach,”

David Falk on John Calipari, Feb 11, 2020. Source: 247Sports.

item.title: David Falk on John Calipari
item.description:
“If my boy 'World Wide Wes' — who I've known forever — is a part of the package, he's one of the great personalities I've ever met. Really well-connected guy. Really interesting person. I really hope it works. AndI will take bets — despite the denials — I will take bets on Calipari being the (Knicks) coach next year.”

David Falk on John Calipari, Feb 11, 2020. Source: 247Sports.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on John Calipari
item.description:
“He can call me a bully, but when [Calipari] sees me, I'm gonna confront him about it,”

Jimmy Butler on John Calipari, Jan 22, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on John Calipari
item.description:
“I tell it how it is. Whenever I was in college,I had [Marquette coach] Buzz Williams to tell me how it was. I didn't have a bunch of McDonald's All Americans like [Calipari] has. So, he can look at it a different way.”

Jimmy Butler on John Calipari, Jan 22, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kenyon Martin on Mike Woodson, Lawrence Frank, John Calipari
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Kenyon Martin on Calipari rumors:

“If its me, I would probably go a different route. I feel like Mike Woodson & Lawrence Frank deserve another shot.”

Kenyon Martin on Mike Woodson, Lawrence Frank, John Calipari, Jan 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Xavier McDaniel on John Calipari
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Xavier McDaniel on John Calipari rumors to the #Nets:

“I think he should stay in college & he is more suited for college.”

Xavier McDaniel on John Calipari, Jan 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Vlade Divac on John Calipari
item.description:
“The only person in our organization who [handles] something like this is me, and I've had zero conversations with John Calipari. We have a coach here.”

Vlade Divac on John Calipari, Jun 30, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Willie Cauley-Stein on John Calipari, DeMarcus Cousins
item.description:
Bill Herenda:Willie Cauley-Stein on playing with DeMarcus Cousins:

“For sure. That’s a force. We both played for John Calipari. He’s more power guy. I’m more finesse”

Willie Cauley-Stein on John Calipari, DeMarcus Cousins, Jun 11, 2015. Source: Twitter @billherenda.

item.title: John Black on John Calipari
item.description:
Sam Amick:Lakers spokesman John Black on Rex Chapman's Calipari report:

“I spoke to (GM) mitch (Kupchak) and he said there is no truth to it...”

John Black on John Calipari, Apr 7, 2014. Source: Twitter @sam_amick.
